question_summary: Request approval to substitute ABS DWV piping in lieu of specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping (Spec Section 22 13 16) prior to ordering so work can proceed before fixture rough-in.
proposed_solution: Approve ABS DWV piping as an alternate to no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: The request changes the specified DWV piping system and requires the plumbing engineer’s review for code compliance, performance, and coordination impacts.
